import type {VhostRouter} from '../../../lib/vhost';
import * as middleware from '../../../middleware';
import type {ReqWithData} from '../../../middleware/oauth/types';
import {resourceHelpers} from '../../../middleware/oauth/enforceUserPermissions';
import {SCOPES} from '../../../lib/logic/oauth/scopes';
import {ENTITLEMENT_KEYS} from '@packages/systems/billing/common';

import {listBranchesHandler} from '../../../controllers/branches/listBranchesHandler';
import {getBranchHandler} from '../../../controllers/branches/getBranchHandler';
import {getBranchConflictsHandler} from '../../../controllers/branches/getBranchConflictsHandler';
import {createBranchHandler} from '../../../controllers/branches/createBranchHandler';
import {deleteBranchHandler} from '../../../controllers/branches/deleteBranchHandler';
import {updateBranchHandler} from '../../../controllers/branches/updateBranchHandler';
import {mergeBranchHandler} from '../../../controllers/branches/mergeBranchHandler';
import {getBranchTaskHandler} from '../../../controllers/branches/getBranchTaskHandler';
import {publishBranchHandler} from '../../../controllers/branches/publishBranchHandler';

export default (app: VhostRouter) => {
  /**
   * List all branches for a site.
   * Supports pagination via `limit` and `offset` query params.
   */
  app.get(
    ['/beta/sites/:site_id/branches'],
    middleware.validateQueryPublicAPI({
      type: 'object',
      additionalProperties: false,
      properties: {
        limit: {type: 'string', pattern: '^[1-9]\\d*$'},
        offset: {type: 'string', pattern: '^\\d+$'},
      },
    }),
    middleware.validateMongoIdParams(['site_id']),
    middleware.oauth,
    middleware.oauth.restrictScopes([SCOPES.BRANCHES_READ]),
    middleware.oauth.loadSiteV2,
    middleware.restrictBooleanEntitlement(
      ENTITLEMENT_KEYS.ALLOW_PAGE_BRANCHING
    ),
    middleware.oauth.normalizePagination(),
    middleware.asyncWrapNamedFunction(listBranchesHandler)
  );

  /**
   * Get a single branch by ID for a site.
   * Returns the branch with computed status and nextActions.
   */
  app.get(
    ['/beta/sites/:site_id/branches/:branch_id'],
    middleware.validateMongoIdParams(['site_id', 'branch_id']),
    middleware.oauth,
    middleware.oauth.restrictScopes([SCOPES.BRANCHES_READ]),
    middleware.oauth.loadSiteV2,
    middleware.restrictBooleanEntitlement(
      ENTITLEMENT_KEYS.ALLOW_PAGE_BRANCHING
    ),
    middleware.asyncWrapNamedFunction(getBranchHandler)
  );

  /**
   * List the unresolved style/component conflicts between a branch and main.
   * An empty list means the branch can merge without resolutions. Entries
   * match the merge endpoint's 409 `branch_merge_conflict` details, so
   * callers can build `resolutions` for update/merge from either source.
   */
  app.get(
    ['/beta/sites/:site_id/branches/:branch_id/conflicts'],
    middleware.validateMongoIdParams(['site_id', 'branch_id']),
    middleware.oauth,
    middleware.oauth.restrictScopes([SCOPES.BRANCHES_READ]),
    middleware.oauth.loadSiteV2,
    middleware.oauth.loadUser,
    middleware.restrictBooleanEntitlement(
      ENTITLEMENT_KEYS.ALLOW_PAGE_BRANCHING
    ),
    // Layer 2 (DEVPL-4015): the token owner must be able to read the site.
    // Scoped to Site, like the task-status route, since SiteBranch's polar
    // policy has no plain `read` action.
    middleware.oauth.enforceUserPermissions({
      action: 'read',
      getResource: resourceHelpers.site,
    }),
    middleware.asyncWrapNamedFunction(getBranchConflictsHandler)
  );

  /**
   * Get the status of an async branch task by its task ID.
   * Generic poll endpoint reused across branch task operations.
   */
  app.get(
    ['/beta/sites/:site_id/branches/tasks/:task_id'],
    middleware.validateMongoIdParams(['site_id']),
    middleware.validateUUIDParams(['task_id']),
    middleware.oauth,
    middleware.oauth.restrictScopes([SCOPES.BRANCHES_READ]),
    middleware.oauth.loadSiteV2,
    middleware.oauth.loadUser,
    middleware.restrictBooleanEntitlement(
      ENTITLEMENT_KEYS.ALLOW_PAGE_BRANCHING
    ),
    // Layer 2 (DEVPL-4015): the token owner must be able to read the site.
    // Scoped to Site, not SiteBranch, since the task is keyed by UUID here.
    middleware.oauth.enforceUserPermissions({
      action: 'read',
      getResource: resourceHelpers.site,
    }),
    middleware.asyncWrapNamedFunction(getBranchTaskHandler)
  );

  /**
   * Create a new branch for a page.
   * Requires `branches:create` scope and ALLOW_PAGE_BRANCHING entitlement.
   */
  app.post(
    ['/beta/sites/:site_id/branches'],
    middleware.validateBodyPublicAPI({
      type: 'object',
      additionalProperties: false,
      properties: {
        pageId: {$ref: 'wf#/definitions/ObjectId'},
      },
      required: ['pageId'],
    }),
    middleware.validateMongoIdParams(['site_id']),
    middleware.oauth,
    middleware.oauth.restrictScopes([SCOPES.BRANCHES_CREATE]),
    middleware.oauth.loadSiteV2,
    middleware.oauth.loadUser,
    middleware.restrictBooleanEntitlement(
      ENTITLEMENT_KEYS.ALLOW_PAGE_BRANCHING
    ),
    middleware.asyncWrapNamedFunction(createBranchHandler)
  );

  /**
   * Delete a branch by ID for a site.
   * Returns 204 No Content on success.
   */
  app.delete(
    ['/beta/sites/:site_id/branches/:branch_id'],
    middleware.validateMongoIdParams(['site_id', 'branch_id']),
    middleware.oauth,
    middleware.oauth.restrictScopes([SCOPES.BRANCHES_DELETE]),
    middleware.oauth.loadSiteV2,
    middleware.oauth.loadUser,
    middleware.restrictBooleanEntitlement(
      ENTITLEMENT_KEYS.ALLOW_PAGE_BRANCHING
    ),
    middleware.asyncWrapNamedFunction(deleteBranchHandler)
  );

  /**
   * Pull changes from main into a branch without merging.
   * Async operation — returns 202 with a task ID the caller polls.
   * `resolutions` are required when conflicts exist.
   */
  app.post(
    ['/beta/sites/:site_id/branches/:branch_id/update'],
    middleware.validateBodyPublicAPI({
      type: 'object',
      additionalProperties: false,
      properties: {
        resolutions: {
          type: 'array',
          items: {
            type: 'object',
            additionalProperties: false,
            properties: {
              // Style/component conflict ids are style-block ids — not always
              // ObjectIds (e.g. system defaults like `default-body`), so match
              // the `Resolution` data-type which types `id` as a plain string.
              id: {type: 'string', minLength: 1},
              resolution: {type: 'string', enum: ['main', 'branch']},
              type: {type: 'string', enum: ['style', 'component']},
            },
            required: ['id', 'resolution', 'type'],
          },
        },
      },
    }),
    middleware.validateMongoIdParams(['site_id', 'branch_id']),
    middleware.oauth,
    middleware.oauth.restrictScopes([SCOPES.BRANCHES_UPDATE]),
    middleware.oauth.loadSiteV2,
    middleware.oauth.loadUser,
    middleware.restrictBooleanEntitlement(
      ENTITLEMENT_KEYS.ALLOW_PAGE_BRANCHING
    ),
    middleware.asyncWrapNamedFunction(updateBranchHandler)
  );

  /**
   * Merge a branch into main. Async operation — returns 202 with a task ID the
   * caller polls. When unresolved conflicts exist and no `resolutions` are
   * supplied, returns 409 `branch_merge_conflict` with the conflict list inline
   * so the caller can retry with `resolutions` to resolve-and-merge in one step.
   */
  app.post(
    ['/beta/sites/:site_id/branches/:branch_id/merge'],
    middleware.validateBodyPublicAPI({
      type: 'object',
      additionalProperties: false,
      properties: {
        resolutions: {
          type: 'array',
          items: {
            type: 'object',
            additionalProperties: false,
            properties: {
              // Style/component conflict ids are style-block ids — not always
              // ObjectIds (e.g. system defaults like `default-body`), so match
              // the `Resolution` data-type which types `id` as a plain string.
              id: {type: 'string', minLength: 1},
              resolution: {type: 'string', enum: ['main', 'branch']},
              type: {type: 'string', enum: ['style', 'component']},
            },
            required: ['id', 'resolution', 'type'],
          },
        },
      },
    }),
    middleware.validateMongoIdParams(['site_id', 'branch_id']),
    middleware.oauth,
    middleware.oauth.restrictScopes([SCOPES.BRANCHES_MERGE]),
    middleware.oauth.loadSiteV2,
    middleware.oauth.loadUser,
    middleware.restrictBooleanEntitlement(
      ENTITLEMENT_KEYS.ALLOW_PAGE_BRANCHING
    ),
    middleware.asyncWrapNamedFunction(mergeBranchHandler)
  );

  /**
   * Publish a branch to its staging domain for preview. Returns 202 with the
   * queued publish task (`taskId`/`status`), the staging domain, the
   * publish-trigger timestamp, and nextActions; the publish is dispatched to
   * the site-publish queue, so callers poll `taskId` for completion.
   */
  app.post(
    ['/beta/sites/:site_id/branches/:branch_id/publish'],
    middleware.validateMongoIdParams(['site_id', 'branch_id']),
    middleware.oauth,
    middleware.oauth.restrictScopes([SCOPES.BRANCHES_PUBLISH]),
    middleware.oauth.loadSiteV2,
    middleware.oauth.loadUser,
    middleware.restrictBooleanEntitlement(
      ENTITLEMENT_KEYS.ALLOW_PAGE_BRANCHING
    ),
    // Layer 2 (DEVPL-4015): enforce the token owner's SiteBranch `publish`
    // permission so a user-scoped token can't become a confused deputy for a
    // user who lacks publish access. Flag-gated (default off) — wired now so a
    // flag flip enforces without a follow-up PR.
    middleware.oauth.enforceUserPermissions({
      action: 'publish',
      getResource: (req: ReqWithData) => ({
        type: 'SiteBranch',
        id: req.params?.branch_id,
      }),
    }),
    middleware.asyncWrapNamedFunction(publishBranchHandler)
  );
};
